verdicts.reason: A keeps the brand → headline → subhead → CTA order, but the flavour pills are blown up to compete with the CTA. They sit in a ragged, staggered cluster: Cucumber Mint juts against the left edge and the bottom row is jammed at the canvas bottom, which leaves dead space on the left. B has a strong headline, but its right edge nearly touches the canvas. The subhead is squeezed into a narrow 3-line column, and the pills are scattered and out of order (Honey Rosemary, Cucumber Mint, Blood Orange) with no shared alignment. Its lower half reads as random fragments around the CTA.
